svg.title: The social-engineering toolkit: at a distance and in person
svg.desc: Phishing family: phishing casts a wide net by email; spear phishing targets a researched person; whaling targets executives, often as CEO fraud; vishing uses the phone; smishing uses text messages; pharming redirects a correct web address to a fake site by tampering with DNS. Other distance techniques: pretexting, baiting with infected USB drives, quid pro quo, and reverse social engineering. In person: tailgating, piggybacking, dumpster diving, and shoulder surfing.
svg.text: The social-engineering toolkit: at a distance and in person

g.text: cause a problem, then fix it
